d: We have an urgent requirement for Head of IT Audit in banking domain is required for our banking client in Oman
Lead the Bank’s IT Audit function, develop risk-based audit plans, and provide independent assurance on IT governance, technology controls, and regulatory compliance..---Must
Conduct audits covering cybersecurity, information security, cloud security, IAM, vulnerability management, data protection, and technology risk frameworks..--Must
Review and audit Core Banking, Digital Banking, Payment Systems, SWIFT, infrastructure, applications, disaster recovery, and business continuity controls.--Must
Partner with senior management, regulators, and business leaders, present audit findings to executive committees, and lead high-performing IT Audit teams.---Must

The Head of IT Audit is responsible for leading and managing the Bank's Information Technology Audit function, providing independent assurance on the effectiveness of IT governance, cybersecurity, digital transformation initiatives, IT operations, infrastructure, cloud environments, and technology risk management practices. The role ensures that technology controls, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices are effectively implemented and monitored across the Bank.Key ResponsibilitiesIT Audit Leadership
Develop and execute the annual IT Audit strategy and risk-based audit plan.
Lead IT audits across applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, digital banking systems, and third-party service providers.
Ensure audit coverage for emerging technologies, digital initiatives, and technology transformation programs.
Present audit observations, risks, and recommendations to senior management and Audit Committee.
Assess the effectiveness of IT governance frameworks and technology risk management practices.
Evaluate compliance with regulatory requirements, Central Bank regulations, and internal policies.
Review IT strategy alignment with business objectives and organizational risk appetite.
Monitor remediation of audit findings and validate closure of management actions.
Conduct audits covering cybersecurity governance, vulnerability management, IAM, network security, data protection, and incident response.
Review security controls aligned with ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, SWIFT, and other relevant frameworks.
Assess effectiveness of SOC operations, threat management, and security monitoring processes.
Evaluate controls over data centers, networks, servers, operating systems, databases, and cloud environments.
Review disaster recovery, business continuity, backup, and resilience frameworks.
Assess technology projects, system implementations, and change management processes.
Audit core banking systems, internet banking, mobile banking, payment systems, cards, and digital channels.
Review SDLC, DevSecOps, application security, system integrations, APIs, and technology architecture controls.
Assess data integrity, availability, confidentiality, and system performance controls.
Collaborate with business leaders, technology teams, risk management, compliance, and external auditors.
Provide advisory services on technology risk, cybersecurity, and control improvements.
Build strong relationships with regulators and external audit partners.
Lead, mentor, and develop the IT Audit team.
Establish performance objectives, training plans, and succession strategies.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within Internal Audit.
q: 12+ years of experience in IT Audit, Information Security, Technology Risk, or IT Governance.
Minimum 5 years in a leadership or management role.
Proven experience within Banking or Financial Services.
Strong exposure to Core Banking, Digital Banking, Payments, Cards, and Regulatory environments.
Experience managing enterprise-wide IT audits and technology risk assessments.
CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
CGEIT (Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT)

d: We are looking for an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to manage and coordinate daily logistics activities, including shipments, transportation, deliveries, and inventory movements. The successful candidate will ensure timely delivery of goods, maintain accurate shipping documentation, and coordinate with suppliers, drivers, warehouse teams, and customers to support smooth supply chain operations.
Coordinate daily transportation, shipment, and delivery activities.
Arrange and monitor incoming and outgoing shipments.
Communicate with suppliers, transport companies, drivers, and warehouse personnel.
Track shipments and provide delivery status updates to relevant departments.
Prepare and maintain shipping documents, delivery notes, invoices, and other logistics records.
Coordinate loading, unloading, storage, and distribution activities.
Ensure deliveries are completed within scheduled timelines.
Monitor transportation schedules and resolve delivery delays or logistical issues.
Maintain accurate records of shipment details, delivery status, and transportation costs.
Assist with inventory movement and warehouse coordination.
Follow up with suppliers and logistics partners regarding pending deliveries.
Identify operational issues and recommend improvements to logistics processes.
Ensure compliance with company procedures and applicable transportation requirements.
Prepare regular logistics reports for management.
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in logistics coordination, transportation, shipping, or warehouse operations is an advantage.
Basic knowledge of logistics operations, shipment tracking, and delivery coordination.
Familiarity with shipping documents, delivery notes, invoices, and inventory records.
Good computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Experience with ERP, inventory, or logistics management systems is an advantage.
Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet delivery deadlines.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to coordinate effectively with drivers, suppliers, customers, and internal departments.
Professional attitude, reliability, and willingness to learn.
Good English communication skills; additional languages are an advantage.
Willingness to work on-site in Dubai, UAE.
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
Employment visa in accordance with company policy and applicable UAE regulations.
Medical insurance as applicable under UAE requirements.
Annual leave and public holidays in accordance with UAE labour law.
End-of-service benefits, where applicable under UAE law.
Professional training and logistics skills development.
Opportunities for career advancement based on performance.
Accommodation, transportation, or other allowances may be available depending on company policy and the employment package.
